title: Zero Carb Portuguese Eggplant Casserole
description: A yeasty and creamy keto-friendly Portuguese dish featuring eggplant, this casserole is kid-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is made with blanched eggplant and has zero carbs.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Blanch the sliced eggplant in boiling water for 5 minutes to remove bitterness.
Remove the eggplant from the water and let it cool on a paper towel-lined plate.
In a large bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, eggs, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and dried oregano.
Add the shredded mozzarella cheese and grated parmesan cheese to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Add the cooled eggplant slices to the bowl and stir gently to coat with the cheese mixture.
Transfer the eggplant mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
